detail: Full summary: H2b at honest magnitude still supports the archive concern: 2757 findings archived against 209 live is ~13x, and 100% of 38 sweeps hit same-day entries. Aggressive but not annihilating — the fix is count-based retention (retain newest K), never an age cutoff.
